title: Battle of Trois-Rivières
text: The Battle of Trois-Rivières was fought on June 8, 1776, during the American Revolutionary War. A British army under Quebec Governor Sir Guy Carleton defeated an attempt by units from the Continental Army under the command of Brigadier General William Thompson to stop a British advance up the Saint Lawrence River valley. The battle occurred as a part of the American invasion of Quebec, which had begun in September 1775 with the goal of removing the province from British rule.
